title: Grateful Dead Live at The Auditorium on 1970-02-23
lineage: SBD > MR > Cass > DAT > CDR > EAC (secure) > Cool Edit (minor fixes) > CD Wave (retracking) > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality soundboard capture of a fragmented 1970 show with intimate acoustic gems and a surprisingly strong Not Fade Away jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is an uneven, slightly muddy soundboard fragment that drops in the middle of a set, but it delivers several standout acoustic moments – Little Sadie, Seasons of My Heart, Me & My Uncle and a fiery Not Fade Away.  Jerry’s Strat tone and Pigpen’s rare organ work shine, though the mix is uneven and parts of Mason’s are missing.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating (~3.3) combined with many positive comments about song performance but consistent complaints about recording fidelity and incomplete set length.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Slightly muddy, occasional mic distortion on Bobby's vocals, noticeable hum between songs, uneven mix with loud mono‑style vocals; some sections (e.g., Mason’s) cut out.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A short, disjointed fragment that sandwiches a brief acoustic set between electric material; missing opening and closing portions make the sequence feel odd but intimate.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is on his sunburst Strat (gnarly tone) and even trades licks with Pigpen near the NFA ending.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil drives the Not Fade Away jam, providing a strong bass foundation despite the uneven mix.
band_member_comments.Bob: Pigpen’s organ comes forward on NFA and Black Peter; his vocal solo on Me & My Uncle is highlighted, though his mic distorts at times.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ is low but audible, especially on Black Peter and the NFA jam.
